Name: AutoOkAfterDay
Author: praveshnema
Description:
**Auto Skip End of Day Screen**  
Tired of manually clicking through the shipping menu every night? This mod automatically proceeds past the end-of-day screen after a **10-second delay**, giving you time to review your earnings while ensuring a smooth transition to the next day.  
### **Features**  
✔ **Auto-Skips Shipping Menu** – No more clicking "OK" after viewing your sales  
✔ **10-Second Delay** – Enough time to check your earnings before continuing  
✔ **Proper Saving** – Ensures your game saves correctly before moving on  
✔ **Multiplayer Support** – Works for the host player in multiplayer games  
✔ **Safe & Reliable** – Uses the game's native functions to avoid issues  
### **How It Works**  
1. After the shipping menu appears at the end of the day, the mod waits **10 seconds**.  
2. It then **automatically proceeds**, just as if you clicked "OK" yourself.  
3. The game saves normally, and you transition to the next day.  
### **Compatibility**  
✔ Works in **single-player** and **multiplayer** (host only)  
✔ Compatible with **Stardew Valley 1.5+**  
✔ Safe to **add or remove** mid-save  
### **Why Use This Mod?**  
- Saves time when playing long sessions  
- Reduces repetitive clicking  
- Still lets you check your earnings before skipping  
- No risk of lost progress—saving is handled properly  
Perfect for players who want a **more streamlined experience** without missing out on daily summaries. Just install and enjoy smoother day transitions!  
*(For best results, use with SMAPI 3.14+ and the latest Stardew Valley version.)*
